name: Strong Foundations
subtitle: 4-week beginner block · 2 full-body days
lede: Two full-body sessions a week. Each one starts with weights and finishes with cardio. The program protects the shoulder, rebuilds core strength after pregnancy, and builds general fitness for fat loss.
notice: Built around a past shoulder operation and two pregnancies. Exercises marked with ⚠ need your physio's OK first. Stop anything that causes sharp, pinching or joint pain, or leaking, heaviness or pelvic pressure. Check with your physio or doctor before starting.

weeks.name: Week 1
weeks.note: Learn the movements with 2 sets each. Pick weights that feel easy to moderate: about 3 reps left in the tank.

weeks.name: Week 2
weeks.note: Now 3 sets each. Same weights as Week 1, or a little heavier if every rep felt smooth.

weeks.name: Week 3
weeks.note: Add a little weight where you can. Stop about 2 reps short of failure, never to failure.

weeks.name: Week 4
weeks.note: Easy week: 2 sets, Week 2 weights, easy cardio only. Then repeat the block a little heavier.

lifts.name: Goblet squat to box
lifts.cue: Sit back to the box, chest tall

lifts.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
lifts.cue: Hips back, flat back, dumbbells close

lifts.name: Glute bridge
lifts.cue: Breathe out as you lift, pause 2 s

lifts.name: Dead bug
lifts.cue: Lower back stays gently on the floor

steps: 20 min at 5–10% incline, brisk walking pace
You should be able to talk in full sentences

days.title: Walk
items: 30-minute walk, with the kids or on your own
2 minutes of breathing practice: breathe in to expand your ribs, breathe out and gently draw your belly and pelvic floor in
Aim for 7,000–10,000 steps a day; this does a lot for fat loss

days.title: Rest
items: Shoulder exercises from your physio, if you have them

lifts.name: Leg press
lifts.cue: Feet mid-plate, control the way down

lifts.name: Dumbbell step-up
lifts.cue: Push through the heel on the box

days.title: Walk
items: Optional: 10 minutes of the core work from Full Body A (dead bug, glute bridge)

days.title: Optional
items: Something active you enjoy: swim, hike, cycle, play at the park

days.title: Rest
items: Plan the week's meals with protein at every meal

rules: Train in a pain-free range. Pinching or sharp pain means stop that exercise and tell your physio. Normal muscle tiredness is fine.
Breathe out and gently draw your belly and pelvic floor in at the hardest part of each rep. Doming along the middle of your tummy means: make it easier.
Around 100–110 g a day at 65 kg. Protein at every meal helps keep muscle while losing fat.
A small daily deficit. Aim to lose about 0.5% of body weight per week; faster tends to cost muscle.
Daily walking burns more than most workouts and is easy on the joints.
Hard with kids, so protect what you can. Poor sleep makes cravings and fatigue worse.
